    function toggleAnalysisBox62() {
        var box = document.getElementById('analysis-box-62');
        if (box.style.display === 'none' || box.style.display === '') {
            box.style.display = 'block';
            setTimeout(function() {
                box.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            }, 150);
        } else {
            box.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function toggleFullscreenMixed62(btn) {
        var container = btn.previousElementSibling;
        if (container.classList.contains('fullscreen')) {
            container.classList.remove('fullscreen');
            btn.innerHTML = '⛶ Vollbild';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        } else {
            container.classList.add('fullscreen');
            btn.innerHTML = '✕ Schließen';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            var fs = document.querySelector('.content-viz-container-62.fullscreen');
            if (fs) {
                fs.classList.remove('fullscreen');
                fs.nextElementSibling.innerHTML = '⛶ Vollbild';
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            }
        }
    });
